title: Infini Bolide lights: Maximum visibility, minimum weight
site_name: Road cycling news, tests and more
excerpt: The new Infini Bolide bike light weighs just 16 grams, features daytime running lights, USB-C charging and up to 50 hours’ battery life. Full details and prices
content:
New: The Infini Bolide bike light weighs just 16 grams

Small, lightweight and yet highly visible: with the new Bolide, Infini is launching a lighting set aimed at cyclists who want to carry as little extra weight as possible when out and about. The front and rear lights are designed to combine high visibility with easy fitting and improved recyclability. We have all the details on this new product.

Topics in this article

Small, lightweight and, ideally, still highly visible: this is the concept behind Infini’s new Bolide lighting system. Each light weighs just 16 grams and, at just under four centimetres wide, is extremely compact. Nevertheless, the manufacturer promises high visibility both by day and by night.

Front and rear lights with six LEDs

Both the front and rear lights feature six LEDs each. According to the manufacturer, in daytime running light mode, the front light produces up to 100 lumens and the rear light up to 30 lumens. A special light guide is designed to further improve visibility on the road.

The lights are operated via a touch-sensitive switch. This allows you to switch between the various lighting modes without the need for a traditional push-button. Installation is carried out using a tool-free mount with a swivelling base. This is designed to enable the system to be fitted quickly to different bicycles.

A rechargeable battery instead of a disposable product

There is an interesting detail inside. Infini uses a removable lithium battery, which can be removed using standard tools once it has reached the end of its service life. This is in line with the new EU Battery Regulation, which aims to promote better recyclability of batteries.

The manufacturer states that the charging time is around 1.5 hours via USB-C. An indicator shows when the battery is running low.

Up to 50 hours’ running time

Depending on the operating mode, the Bolide light set is designed to last a long time. In Eco-Flash mode, Infini states a maximum runtime of up to 50 hours. Thanks to its IPX6 protection rating, the lights are also designed to function reliably even in bad weather.

Thanks to their light weight and compact dimensions, the Bolide lights are likely to appeal particularly to cyclists looking for the most discreet lighting possible for their road bike, gravel bike or commuter bike.

According to the manufacturer, the new Infini Bolide lighting set is available now.
